subject: POC/Trial plan & next steps — Redwood + HorizonCare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC/Trial plan & next steps — Redwood + HorizonCare

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Recapping action items and proposing a concrete POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. Please review and confirm owners (infra/app/security/procurement) so we can lock dates.

Key success criteria (as discussed):
- Reduce 95th percentile inference latency on typical patient-summary prompts to < 250ms for interactive workflows.
- Achieve embedding similarity recall >= 0.92 on your internal evaluation set (sample attached).
- No sensitive PHI tokens are logged to Redwood control plane (we'll confirm with security controls).

Proposed evaluation plan:
- Phase 0 (Week 0): Onboarding + infra readiness — credentials, whitelist IPs, and test dataset ingest.
- Phase 1 (Week 1-2): Small-scale trial (10k requests/day, representative prompts) to verify latency & embedding recall.
- Phase 2 (Week 3-4): Scale trial to 100k requests/day, run failure scenarios and monitoring for cost/throughput.
- Success review + decision: End of Week 4 — go/no-go for production pilot.

Proposed timeline (target) — tentative start: Mon, 2026-04-06
- Week 0: access + security questionnaire review
- Weeks 1-4: trial phases above

Ownership / RACI (please confirm):
- Redwood infra / runtime: Vivek Kulkarni (redwood) — provide GPU endpoints, network config, and WHITELIST/IP allowlist guidance.
- Redwood integration / app support: Aditya Rao (redwood) — assist with SDK integration, example prompts, and dataset ingest.
- Redwood security / compliance reviewer: Naomi Feldman (redwood) — review questionnaire and provide SOC2 controls mapping.
- HorizonCare app owner: (please confirm) — responsible for integration and feature-level validation.
- HorizonCare infra: (please confirm) — responsible for network/firewall and VPC peering if required.
- HorizonCare procurement: (please confirm) — handle contract/PO and any procurement prerequisites.

Next steps (please reply with confirmations):
1) Confirm owners for HorizonCare (app, infra, security, procurement).
2) Confirm the proposed start week (w/c 2026-04-06) or suggest alternatives.
3) Review the attached POC plan (redwood-horizoncare-poc-plan.pdf) and the security questionnaire we received (I attached HorizonCare's response file).

I've attached the POC plan and the security questionnaire you shared — let me know if you want to run a short alignment call this week (15-30 mins).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-horizoncare-poc-plan.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@horizoncare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@horizoncare.com>, procurement@horizoncare.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC/Trial plan & next steps — Redwood + HorizonCare

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Confirming ownership from our side: 
- App owner: Michael Reynolds (michael.reynolds@horizoncare.com) — will validate feature acceptance criteria and test cases.
- Infra owner: Jason Lee (jason.lee@horizoncare.com) — will handle network/PEERING and firewall rules.
- Security reviewer: Anika Sharma (anika.sharma@horizoncare.com) — will coordinate with Naomi on the security questionnaire.
- Procurement: procurement@horizoncare.com (POC budget already provisioned) — they'll handle contract/PO once we agree on terms.

We are broadly aligned on the success criteria. Two small notes:
1) Latency target — for interactive clinician workflow we may need to test 250ms at P95 for our typical 512-token prompts; happy to start with your target but will raise if our production prompts skew longer.
2) Data: we will provide a de-identified sample dataset for the trial — I'll share SFTP/Drive access by EOD Monday.

Start week 2026-04-06 works for us. Let's schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite after internal confirmation.

Sara Patel
Director, Product — Data & AI, HorizonCare
Sara.Patel@horizoncare.com

Forwarded attachment: horizoncare-security-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC/Trial plan & next steps — Redwood + HorizonCare

Looping in the infra and security owners to start work on access and the questionnaire. A few operational notes from infra/security side: 
- Vivek: can we confirm what network options we want to offer HorizonCare? We can support: 
  * Public-hosted endpoints with IP allowlist (fastest)
  * VPC peering / PrivateLink equivalent (requires HorizonCare infra coordination)
- Vivek will own the endpoint provisioning and sample traffic tests. Aditya: please prepare an integration checklist for HorizonCare (SDK snippet, auth token rotation, sample prompt set).
- Naomi: I'll assign the questionnaire to you. Sara mentioned Anika will coordinate on their side — Naomi, can you provide a short doc mapping our controls to their questionnaire by Wed EOD?

RACI (proposed updates):
- Redwood: Vivek (Accountable for infra readiness), Aditya (Responsible for integration), Naomi (Consulted for security), Lauren (Responsible for POC operations), Marissa (Accountable for overall success / customer liaison).
- HorizonCare: Michael Reynolds (Accountable for acceptance), Jason Lee (Responsible for infra/network), Anika Sharma (Consulted on security), procurement@horizoncare.com (Responsible for contract).
